anya: Heads-up: new canary for zephyr-lite-int4 shows spike in funcall parse anomalies for streaming / ndjson ingestion. rate ~2.1% vs 0.5% baseline.
marco: what's the anomaly class? truncation, extra tokens, ordering?
lina: Mostly boundary sigils and partial escape sequences. e.g. stream chunk ends with `... \"text\": \"hello\` then next chunk starts \"world\\"}` but our reassembly sometimes loses a leading quote.
zane: value-level UTF-8/escape splits are expected with aggressive quantization. Are we reassembling by bytes or tokens?
anya: currently by tokens from runtime; kv-cache streaming can split inside multibyte escapes. suggestion: add a lightweight boundary-sigil that the serving runtime can append for streaming NDJSON in canary mode (e.g., `\u241E` EOT marker) and strip before parsing.
sylvia: adding a sigil changes model output distribution though. prefer sanitizer that repairs common split patterns without changing model prompt.
marco: agreed. Can we do a deterministic reassembly pass: if chunk ends in backslash or an odd number of open quotes, hold until next chunk; if next chunk doesn't arrive within 50ms, mark as truncated. Also heuristically join chunks that together produce valid JSON.
lina: I'll prototype a reassembler: rules = 1) preserve raw chunk stream to logs, 2) attempt incremental parse, 3) if parse fails and suffix matches `\\$` or open-quote imbalance, concatenate next chunk and retry up to 3 concatenations, 4) if still failing, emit parse_error.truncated metric.
zane: routing confounder: rapid retries hitting different mirrors produce inconsistent chunk ordering for same request id. we should attach a stream-session id and sticky-route retries to same host for 5s to avoid that noise.
sylvia: Also observed occasional extra top-level helper `metadata` that older validator treats as unexpected -> fail. For canary only, allow `metadata` as optional top-level key.
anya: Security note: we must not silently accept arbitrary top-level keys in prod. Proposal: CANARY parsing policy = {lenient_reassembly: true, allow_optional_top_keys: ["metadata","meta"], sample_store_rate: 1%}; PROD policy = strict.
marco: perf impact? reassembly retries may add latency. measure p50/p95 before enabling.
lina: will add timing instrumentation. plan: run canary with lenient reassembler and sticky routing on 30% of streaming traffic for 6h. collect metrics: parse_error.{truncated,sigil-inserted,unknown_top_key}, reassembly.attempts histogram, and latency buckets.
zane: implementation note: reassembler should operate on bytes and detect incomplete UTF-8 sequences instead of naive quote counting. use Python's incremental decoder or rust's encoding crate.
sylvia: tests I'll add: stream_reassembly_test covers mid-escape split, mid-multibyte UTF-8 split, trailing comma in NDJSON, and injected JS-style comment suffix.
